recipe.visualDefinition: A 1960s psychedelic illustration featuring a stylized female portrait framed by an ornate, organic border. The central figure is rendered with fluid, swirling ink lines and warm yellow-orange watercolor washes. A multi-tiered ribbon banner at the top contains bubble-like custom lettering, while a secondary text block at the bottom is integrated into a decorative Art Nouveau plinth.
coreVisualRelationships: The central portrait is contained within a vertical archway frame.
The top banner curves upward, mirroring the arch's crown.
The bottom typography acts as a structural base for the entire illustration.
Fluid, organic lines connect the hair of the subject to the surrounding decorative elements.
coreInvariants: Warm, monochromatic-adjacent color scheme of yellows, oranges, and ochres.
Negative space surrounding the central composition is a flat, aged cream color.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally located portrait, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bottom horizontal text block and its ornate yellow scrollwork.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top banner, flows down through the swirling hair and facial features, and rests on the bottom text plinth.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive off-white/cream border surrounding the central graphic element.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm yellow and golden ochre washes for the skin and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep orange and burnt sienna for hair shadows and banner accents.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black ink for all structural outlines and fine details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central figure against a low-saturation, high-value cream background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold display sans and serif hybrids
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Extremely thick, rounded, bubble-like forms with minimal counters and circular decorative motifs inside the strokes.
Bottom text: Geometric Art Nouveau style with varying stroke widths and sharp, elongated serifs.
All letters are hand-drawn to fit specific curved or rectangular containers.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the top banner are warped to follow the arc of the ribbon.
Bottom letters feature exaggerated horizontal bars and stylized, interlocking terminals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between top liquid-bubble forms and bottom structured-geometric forms.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bottom text's geometric Art Nouveau structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a psychedelic ink and watercolor illustration of a woman's portrait with swirling hair, framed by an Art Nouveau arch and a top ribbon banner. Use a palette of yellow, orange, and cream with heavy black outlines. Leave the banner and the bottom plinth area blank for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn bubble lettering to the top ribbon following its curve. Add geometric Art Nouveau lettering to the bottom rectangular plinth. Ensure all text has a black ink outline.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm (yellows/oranges)?
Does the linework have a hand-drawn, variable-width ink quality?
Is the top text warped to fit the ribbon shape?
Is there sufficient cream-colored negative space around the central graphic?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the Art Nouveau scrollwork
Width of the black ink outlines
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness issues
Unique decorative motifs within the letters
Specific scrollwork patterns in the border

mustAchieve: Fluid integration of text and image

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible despite the psychedelic distortion.
Ensure the watercolor washes do not bleed into the cream background area.
Verify the balance between the top and bottom typographic elements.
Confirm the ink outlines are consistent in style across the entire image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central surreal portrait with Art Nouveau framing and 1960s psychedelic bubble lettering, using a warm monochromatic watercolor palette and heavy ink outlines.
